A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same Time-R1 research work, with 23 pages and Appendices A-E. Text comparison and rendered-page inspection support reliable comparison of the text, equations, tables, figures, and appendices.

before.justification: v2 reports original temporal grounding and video question-answering evaluations, component ablations, and qualitative model outputs in Section 4 and Appendices C-E.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results, including the benchmark evaluations in Table 1 and model-size comparisons in Table 7.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Appendix B retain the same Time-R1/TimeRFT procedures, rewards, filtering, cold-start training, and loss design. Table 7's replacement of TimeZero labels with Time-R1 is a naming correction, not a method change.

E1.justification: The TimeRFT training sources, Charades-STA, ActivityNet, TVGBench, and the four video question-answering benchmarks are unchanged. No datasets, tasks, or test scenarios are added or removed.

E2.justification: The comparator sets in the benchmark comparisons and supplementary analyses are unchanged. Table 7 retains the same 3B/7B model variants and fine-tuned variants under corrected Time-R1 names.

E3.justification: Both versions retain the same splits, model sizes, training budgets, Time-R1 frame sampling, and testing procedures. R1@m, mIoU, and video-QA accuracy remain the evaluation metrics.

E4.justification: Section 4.3 and Appendices C-E retain the same reward, filtering, cold-start, KL/CoT, loss-design, and model-size analyses, along with semantic-category analyses and qualitative cases.

E5.justification: The same point estimates and training curves are reported. Neither version provides experimental seed counts, repeated-run uncertainty, confidence intervals, or significance tests.

E6.justification: All numerical results and qualitative outcomes are retained. Matching Table 7's renamed rows confirms identical Charades-STA, ActivityNet, and TVGBench scores; no result entries are added or removed.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and objectives in Equations 1-7, including GRPO and the timestamp-aware reward, are unchanged. No assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the Time-R1, TimeRFT, and TVGBench contributions and the same claims about data-efficient grounding performance and general video understanding.

C2.justification: Result interpretations and mechanism explanations are unchanged. Appendix A retains the same limitations concerning training/inference speed, motion information lost through frame sampling, and handling ultra-long videos.

D1.justification: Implementation settings in Appendix B, training and evaluation prompts, hardware and runtime disclosures, and the project-page link are unchanged. No technical reproducibility or code/data access information is added or removed.

R1.justification: Section 2 and the 66-entry bibliography are unchanged. The relationship to earlier work and the novelty positioning remain the same.

P1.justification: Table 7 changes TimeZero-3B/7B to Time-R1-3B/7B, including starred rows. Zihan Xiao's affiliation changes from Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications to Independent Researcher. The narrative and section structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: The corrected Table 7 labels slightly alter table spacing and the surrounding page layout. Page 1's affiliation block and arXiv version/date stamp change. All other pages render identically, with no figures or tables added or removed.

improvement.justification: Correcting Table 7's TimeZero labels to Time-R1 resolves an internal naming inconsistency and clarifies which models produced the reported scores. This provides a limited clarity improvement; the scientific evidence, methods, and limitations remain unchanged.
